arxiv-2110-00697.title: Clustering and Network Analysis for the Embedding Spaces of Sentences and Sub-Sentences
arxiv-2110-00697.creator: Yuan An, Alexander Kalinowski, Jane Greenberg
arxiv-2110-00697.description: Abstract Sentence embedding methods offer a powerful approach for working with short textual constructs or sequences of words. By representing sentences as dense numerical vectors, many natural language processing (NLP) applications have improved their performance. However, relatively little is understood about the latent structure of sentence embeddings.

arxiv-2210-03488.title: AlphaFold Distillation for Protein Design
arxiv-2210-03488.creator: Igor Melnyk, Aurelie Lozano, Payel Das, Vijil Chenthamarakshan
arxiv-2210-03488.description: Abstract Inverse protein folding, the process of designing sequences that fold into a specific 3D structure, is crucial in bio-engineering and drug discovery. Traditional methods rely on experimentally resolved structures, but these cover only a small fraction of protein sequences. Forward folding models like AlphaFold offer a potential solution by accurately predicting structures from sequences.

arxiv-2403-13506.title: Time-resolved measurement of acoustic density fluctuations using a phase-shifting Mach-Zehnder interferometer
arxiv-2403-13506.creator: Eita Shoji, Anis Maddi, Guillaume Penelet, Tetsushi Biwa
arxiv-2403-13506.description: Abstract Phase-shifting interferometry is one of the optical measurement techniques that improves accuracy and resolution by incorporating a controlled phase shift into conventional optical interferometry. In this study, a four-step phase-shifting interferometer is developed to measure the spatio-temporal distribution of acoustic density oscillations of the gas next to a rigid plate.

arxiv-2506-19478.title: ADDQ: Adaptive Distributional Double Q Q -Learning
arxiv-2506-19478.creator: Leif Döring, Benedikt Wille, Maximilian Birr, Mihail Bîrsan, Martin Slowik
arxiv-2506-19478.description: Abstract Bias problems in the estimation of Q Q -values are a well-known obstacle that slows down convergence of Q Q -learning and actor-critic methods. One of the reasons of the success of modern RL algorithms is partially a direct or indirect overestimation reduction mechanism.

arxiv-2602-03333.description: Abstract . Recent progress in adversarial attacks on 3D point clouds, particularly in achieving spatial imperceptibility and high attack performance, presents significant challenges for defenders. Current defensive approaches remain cumbersome, often requiring invasive model modifications, expensive training procedures or auxiliary data access.

pmc-11400975.title: Unveiling the impact of date-specific analytics on vehicle fuel consumption and emissions: A case study of Shiraz city
pmc-11400975.creator: Elmira Bagheri, Masoud Masih-Tehrani, Mohammad Azadi, Ashkan Moosavian, Sarah Sayegh, Mansour Hakimollahi
pmc-11400975.description: Understanding the factors affecting internal combustion engine performance is crucial for improving emissions and fuel efficiency in real traffic. This paper investigates the influence of date-specific factors, such as working days and holidays on fuel consumption and emissions of a representative internal combustion engine in the context of Shiraz city.

pmc-11476963.title: The Antidepressant Drug Amitriptyline Affects Human SH-SY5Y Neuroblastoma Cell Proliferation and Modulates Autophagy
pmc-11476963.creator: Annagrazia Adornetto, Maria Luisa Laganà, Andrea Satriano, Ester Licastro, Maria Tiziana Corasaniti, Giacinto Bagetta, Rossella Russo
pmc-11476963.description: Amitriptyline is a tricyclic antidepressant commonly used for depressive disorders and is prescribed off-label for several neurological conditions like neuropathic pain, migraines and anxiety. Besides their action on the reuptake of monoaminergic neurotransmitters, tricyclic antidepressants interact with several additional targets that may contribute to either therapeutic or adverse effects.

pmc-11676745.title: Removal of Ciprofloxacin and Norfloxacin from Aqueous Solution with Activated Carbon from Cupuaçu (Theobroma grandiflorum) Bark
pmc-11676745.creator: Rafael Alves do Nascimento, Nilson dos Reis de Oliveira Novaes, Demetrius Pereira Morilla, Patricia Teresa Souza da Luz, Cristiane Maria Leal Costa, Lênio José Guerreiro de Faria
pmc-11676745.description: The widespread use of antibiotics such as fluoroquinolones (FQs) has raised environmental and health concerns. This study is innovative as we investigate the removal of ciprofloxacin (CIP) and norfloxacin (NOR) from water using activated carbon derived from cupuaçu bark (CAC). This previously discarded biomass is now a low-cost raw material for the production of activated carbon, boosting the local economy.

pmc-12667717.title: Engineering Biomimetic Nanoplatforms for Acute Lung Injury: From Mechanistic Insights to Translational Opportunities
pmc-12667717.creator: Yukun Liu, Kang Wang, Fangli Gao, Zhikai Xu, Xuan Zhao, Xiangjun Bai, Zhanfei Li, Guoyun Wan, Jian Yang, Yuchang Wang
pmc-12667717.description: Acute lung injury (ALI) remains a critical clinical challenge characterized by uncontrolled inflammation, oxidative stress, and immune dysregulation, with limited therapeutic options and high mortality. In recent years, biomimetic nanoplatforms—including those derived from cell membranes, extracellular vesicles (EVs), and hybrid biological interfaces—have emerged as transformative tools for ALI management.

pmc-12836447.title: Postoperative Analgesic Effect of Bupivacaine and Magnesium Sulphate vs. Bupivacaine and Dexmedetomidine in Transversus Abdominis Plane Block
pmc-12836447.creator: Vinisha S, Kala B, Sathyasuba M, Dipika B, Nithish Kumar, Yogesh Manickam Dominic Savio
pmc-12836447.description: BackgroundEffective postoperative analgesia plays a crucial role in enhancing recovery following laparoscopic surgeries. The transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block, when combined with adjuvants, has shown promising results in prolonging analgesia. Among the commonly studied adjuvants, magnesium sulphate and dexmedetomidine are frequently compared, but their relative efficacy remains debated.

pmc-12992987.title: Selenotrisulfide delivery restores redox balance in myocardial infarction via a thiol-exchange reaction in situ
pmc-12992987.creator: Shifen Li, Beiduo Wang, Weiwei Zheng, Xinman Hu, Liyin Shen, Jun Deng, Yang Zhu, Wenxing Liu, Changyou Gao
pmc-12992987.description: The enzyme activity of redox-related selenoproteins is impaired post-tissue injury or inflammation, exacerbating oxidative stress and apoptosis. In this study, we present a strategy using selenotrisulfide (STS) to enhance the selenium content and restore selenoprotein-like activity in vivo via thiol-exchange reactions.

pmc-13458129.title: Development of a Diagnostic Tool for Elbow Instability Combining 4D-CT Imaging and Mechanical Load Analysis
pmc-13458129.creator: Jonas Gehring, Fabian Forster, Markus Meindl, Martin Maerz, Michael Simon, Nina Renner, Michael Uder, Tobias Pogarell, Lars Braeuer, Mario Perl, Lucas Mangold
pmc-13458129.description: BackgroundDiagnosis of elbow instability in clinical practice commonly relies on manual stress testing by the physician with or without combination of fluoroscopy or ultrasound, which may result in variable force application and subjective interpretation. A standardized method for applying controlled mechanical loading during dynamic imaging may improve reproducibility.

pmc-13500862.title: 以尿崩症起病累及垂体柄的罕见Rosai-Dorfman病1例
pmc-13500862.creator: Lusha LI, Honghui HE, Shaoli ZHAO, Ling CHU, Ping JIN, 敏宁 彭
pmc-13500862.description:
A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Rosai-Dorfman病(Rosai-Dorfman disease，RDD)是一类罕见的非朗格汉斯细胞组织细胞增生症。2024年8月中南大学湘雅三医院内分泌科收治1例38岁男性，以尿崩症为首发症状，病情迁延15年，逐渐进展为全垂体功能减退症。影像学提示垂体柄明显增粗、2处硬脑膜瘤样结节、多发骨质破坏、少许间质性肺炎及泌尿系统受累。经垂体柄活体组织检查后确诊为RDD，伴有BRAF V600E突变，予以BRAF抑制剂达拉非尼靶向治疗和垂体激素替代治疗。治疗8个月后复查头部磁共振，提示垂体柄增粗较前好转，2处硬脑膜瘤样结节消失，且患者生活质量明显改善。对本病例进行回顾性分析，可帮助临床医师对垂体柄增粗进行病因诊断及鉴别诊断，提高对RDD这一罕见疾病的认识。Keywords: Rosai-Dorfman病, 尿崩症, 垂体柄增粗, 多系统受累, BRAF突变

临床上中枢性尿崩症和垂体柄增粗可同时出现或先后出现，其病因诊断复杂且困难。很多患者在初次就诊时不一定能得到正确的诊断[1]。本研究报道1例以尿崩症为首发症状、病程长达15年的侵犯垂体柄、硬脑膜、骨骼等多系统的Rosai-Dorfman病(Rosai-Dorfman disease，RDD)患者，以提高内科医师对垂体柄增粗的诊断及鉴别诊断的能力，并认识这一疾病。

病例资料

患者，男，38岁，因“口干、多饮、多尿15年余，言语不利1个月余”于2024年8月2日入住中南大学湘雅三医院内分泌科(以下简称“我科”)。患者疾病自然史如图1所示。患者15年前无明显诱因出现口干、多饮、多尿，每日饮水3 000~4 000 mL，夜尿3~4次，曾在外院考虑“肾性尿崩症？”，出院后长期服用氢氯噻嗪和卡马西平，但疗效欠佳，遂于2013年3月14日第1次入住我科，禁水加压试验结果提示禁水后最高尿比重达1.020，尿渗透压616 mOsm/kg，垂体磁共振(magnetic resonance imaging，MRI)平扫及增强未见异常(图2A和2B)，诊断为“精神性烦渴”出院。出院后患者仍感口干多饮多尿，近年饮水量及尿量均为6 000~7 000 mL，夜间需起床上厕所及饮水3~4次。半年前患者自觉体力下降，性欲减退，体毛脱落，体重减轻约15 kg。入院前1个月无明显诱因出现言语不利，主要表现为吐词欠清，无头痛和视力下降，在外院MRI检查提示鞍区占位，为求进一步治疗遂第2次入我科。既往体健，否认传染病史，否认重大外伤、手术史。

pmc-13623873.title: Modeling nonlinear and interaction effects of spatiotemporal and nongenetic factors improves prediction for complex traits
pmc-13623873.creator: Ross DeVito, Melissa Gymrek
pmc-13623873.description: Adjusting for nongenetic factors improves genetic association testing and polygenic scores, yet most studies rely on linear adjustments for limited covariate sets. Location and time covariates can proxy environmental exposures but are rarely included, and linear adjustments cannot capture their nonlinear effects or interactions. We adopt a null model approach where an auxiliary nonlinear model predicts phenotypes from covariates alone.
